core_obligations: Show that a flat pullback of finite presentation is finite locally free and so decomposes T by rank (proof lines 1485-1491).
Identify F_flat with the coproduct of the rank-r functors F_r (proof lines 1491-1495).
Read off the representing object as the coproduct of Z_{r-1} \ Z_r (proof lines 1495-1499).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a finitely presented module F on a scheme S with the closed subschemes Z_i of the locally-free-rank lemma, the coproduct of the locally closed S_r = Z_{r-1} \ Z_r represents the functor F_flat of morphisms T -> S whose pullback of F is flat, and F|S_r is locally free of rank r with S_r -> S and S' -> S of finite presentation (source lines 1464-1483). The proof shows that a flat pullback F_T of finite presentation is finite locally free, decomposes T as the coproduct of its rank strata T_r, identifies F_flat with the coproduct of the functors F_r of the locally-free-rank lemma, and reads off the representing object.
